name: DocStash
description:
DocStash gives your AI-generated pages, reports, and apps a single stable home. Create and stash documents directly from your agent and publish them at a permanent, shareable URL.

Stash HTML, Markdown, PDF, Word, Excel, code, and live apps (React, Vue, Three.js, and more)!

You can retrieve and iterate on your documents from any AI agent you've connected, no matter which one first created them. Every edit becomes a new version at the same URL.

_published_faq.name: How do I add DocStash to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DocStash to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.docstash.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DocStash MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DocStash lists 21 MCP tools, including create_app, create_docx, create_page, create_pdf, create_sheet, create_text, discard, get_docx, get_organizations, get_page, get_pdf, and get_sheet.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DocStash?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DocStash in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
DocStash requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DocStash is developed by DocStash. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
